title: Degree under domain translation
statement: Let $n\ge 0$, let $f:\mathbb{F}_2^n\to\mathbb{F}_2$ be a Boolean function, and let $z\in\mathbb{F}_2^n$. The function $x\mapsto f(x+z)$ has the same algebraic degree as $f$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional binary cube
$z$ is a point of that cube
